name: player-walk-jump
comment: WP-2.5a. The input op (MovementInput as MovementInputFromOptions computes it; HarnessPlayer applies it where EntityPlayerSP.updatePlayerActionState does). A stone platform (y 60, x -8..8, z -4..16) with a raised part (y 61, z 8..16). The player (id 0) walks forward (+z, yaw 0) from t 2, presses jump from t 28 to climb the step, strafes left (+x) from t 50, then sneak-strafes toward the east edge from t 75: Entity.moveEntity's sneak guard (onGround && isSneaking, the HarnessPlayer/EntityPlayerSP override) stops it at the edge. Released at t 165.
